propositions: User identity representation differs between Cloud (opaque accountId) and Data Center (username name), requiring a pluggable contract to handle both
PR #120's DC implementation used unreachable getattr-discovery of _assignee_resolver, causing it to return authoritative=False for all assignees and re-emit unconverged changes
NameIdentity must perform real lookup against DC user-search endpoint to return authoritative=True and prevent assignee-diff churn
The Protocol must expose resolve(local_value, remote_identity) returning (value, authoritative, is_account_id) and to_payload(value) for the deployment-specific assignee field shape

AccountIdIdentity for Cloud and NameIdentity for DC must both pass shared contract tests covering empty local value, converged identity, different identity, and unresolvable assignee raising BackendAssigneeNotFoundError
